visual_description: The image displays a logo for the "Healthy Brain Initiative" with the subtitle "Road Map for Indian Country." On the left side is a stylized blue brain icon composed of geometric shapes. The text "HEALTHY BRAIN" appears in large, bold, dark blue capital letters on the top line, with "INITIATIVE" directly below it in slightly smaller but still bold capital letters. Beneath that, the phrase "Road Map for Indian Country" is written in a lighter blue, sentence-case font. The entire composition is set against a white background.

The image displays the logo of the National Council of Urban Indian Health. The design features a circular emblem with stylized human figures in blue against a white background, incorporating elements like a city skyline and a sunburst pattern. Text encircles the central graphic, reading "NATIONAL COUNCIL OF URBAN INDIAN HEALTH" in uppercase letters.
